summary: The diff implements changes to Navigation.tsx, useIsCallerAdmin.ts, useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout.ts, and AdminDashboard.tsx that collectively address all three requirements. REQ-1 is addressed by showing the Admin link only when phase==='confirmed' && isAdmin, plus a retry button on timeout/error. REQ-2 is addressed by AdminDashboard rendering AdminCollectionForm and AdminNFTForm with proper phase-based loading states. REQ-3 is addressed by refactoring both hooks with fallback logic, retries, and a 30-second timeout with retry capability. All acceptance criteria appear covered.
